root_problem: 当前全房通首页承载登录、续费、下载、客服和公告入口，但入口关系与边界需要被收敛成可验证的专业入口中心。
business_goals: 把当前首页定义为专业入口中心，集中承载登录、续费、下载、客服和公告入口
通过标准链路产出可被下游消费、验证和签收的 phase-1 原型需求
明确所有真实后端能力未集成，避免把原型验收误判为线上发布能力
acceptance_criteria: 用户能在原型中识别登录、续费、下载、客服和公告入口的业务意图
桌面和移动视口都能呈现入口中心的核心信息层级
涉及真实登录、支付、下载、客服、后端、鉴权、发布或回滚的能力不得被声明为已集成
design_decisions: Design must decide the entry center layout and interaction states without adding production backend integration.
non_functional_requirements: 入口文案、状态反馈和未集成边界必须能被业务、测试和交付角色直接理解
原型验收必须保留 desktop and mobile evidence targets
scope_boundaries: include password, verification-code, and QR login entry switching as prototype behavior
include renewal prompt acknowledgement or dismissal as prototype behavior
include download, support, and announcement entries with visible prototype feedback
include desktop and mobile responsive prototype acceptance
exclude real backend, real payment, real download, real support, telemetry, auth, deployment, and rollback

delivery_plan.goal: deliver and verify the homepage entry center prototype artifact chain
